body:
A highlight of Christiane Amanpour’s recent report on Nigeria is her talk with Desmond and Mpho Tutu at the end of this seg ment. Quotable:

 Evil systems don’t last forever. They bite the dust!

 I developed the hide of a rhinoceros.

 God is waiting for human collaborators.
